testOverlayHint: Shows the actual overlay for 8 seconds. No keys are sent.
addEmpty: Add a stratagem from the catalogue
languageHelp: Applied immediately, including the overlay. Unsupported system languages use English.
bindingsHelp: Match these bindings to your Helldivers 2 settings.
captureHelp: Letters show physical QWERTY positions. Use Capture for your keyboard layout. Escape cancels.
gameHelp: The wheel enters the code; throwing stays manual. Use borderless windowed mode.
transferHelp: Profiles and settings are saved automatically on this computer.
importHelp: Import replaces your profiles. Export them first to keep a copy.
creditsText: Names and codes: Helldivers Wiki. Icons: nvigneux and contributors. Direction arrows: Dogo314, via the wiki.
unaffiliated: Independent community project, not affiliated with Arrowhead or Sony.
simulationHint: No keys sent to the game
simulationGuide: Move the mouse · Click to select · Right-click to go back / close · Escape to cancel
loadError: Invalid saved data. Default profile loaded.
saveError: Local save failed. Export your profiles.
maxSectors: A wheel can contain up to 12 sectors.
nativeOnly: Open the Windows app to test the overlay.
keyboardOnly: In-game bindings must use keyboard keys.
duplicateKeys: Use distinct keys for the wheel and in-game controls.
invalidRange: A control setting is outside its allowed range.
invalidTree: Invalid or overly deep menu tree.
releaseShortcut: Release the shortcut before changing settings.
notReady: The Windows engine is not ready. Check Connection below.
inputRefused: Windows refused input. Check that the game and SERAPOD use the same privilege level.
inputCancelled: Input cancelled after Escape or a window change.
releaseGameKeys: Release the in-game stratagem keys before confirming.
hookFailed: Windows input hooks could not be installed.
overlayFailed: The overlay could not be shown.
glassHelp: Translucent panels, soft light and highlighted edges. Text and icons stay fully visible.
dropCycle: A folder cannot be moved into itself.
dragHint: Onto a stratagem: replace or swap. Between sectors: insert. Onto a folder: move inside.
glassUnavailable: Overlay initialization failed. Try restarting the overlay.
resetAppConfirm: Restore the default wheel and all settings? All custom profiles will be removed. Export them first if you want to keep them.
updateQuestion: Update now? Your profiles and settings will be kept. SERAPOD will restart when the download is ready.
updateLatest: SERAPOD {version} is the latest stable release.
updateNetwork: GitHub could not be reached. Check your connection and try again later. Your current version is unchanged.
updateInvalid: This release does not have a compatible, verifiable executable. Please download it manually from the SERAPOD GitHub releases page.
updateBusy: An update is already in progress.
updateWrite: The update could not be saved next to this executable. Move SERAPOD to a writable folder and try again; no existing executable was replaced.
updateIntegrity: The downloaded file did not match the release checksum or size. It will not be launched. Your current version is unchanged.
updateRestart: The new version could not start. Keep using this version, or download the release manually from GitHub.
updateCleanup: The update is running, but Windows could not remove the old executable. You can delete the older version manually.
